description: Fetch a Monkeytype profile by username or uid. Defaults to MONKEYTYPE_USERNAME. Returns a compact summary unless compact=false.

compact.description: Return a summary instead of the full profile payload. Defaults to true.

isUid.description: Treat uidOrName as a uid instead of a name.

uidOrName.description: Username or uid. Keywords me/self/current/my resolve to MONKEYTYPE_USERNAME.

name: get_profile
title: Get profile
